# RutinHQ — full text for LLMs

Canonical host: https://www.rutinhq.com/
Optional locale prefix: /es (hub, SKU landings, blog). English is the commercial base.

RutinHQ installs operating systems teams own — not retainers that vanish.
Three installable operating systems. Pick the bottleneck. One page, one SKU.

This file is factual public copy. It does not publish prices, retainers, or rate cards.
GROK BOT OS is a public catalog curriculum sheet, not a fourth commercial hub card.

Contact:
- Email: strategy@rutinhq.com
- 30-min fit call: https://calendly.com/rutinhq/30min

## Products (live hub / LP one-liners)

### GTM OS
URL: https://www.rutinhq.com/gtm-os
Hub thesis: B2B outbound that stays with your team — cold, ICP-filtered, milestone-gated.
Headline: Outbound that stays yours.
Subhead: A cold B2B prospecting system installed in your team — not a rented SDR that dies when the contract ends. Change language, filters, and angle; keep the core.
Catalog: https://docs.rutinhq.com/catalog/gtm-os/

### STORE OS
URL: https://www.rutinhq.com/store-os
Hub thesis: Shopify Admin audit + config so the store converts before you spend on ads.
Headline: Make the store convert before you buy ads.
Subhead: Replicable Shopify Admin audit + config — variants, price, weight, shipping — so ops friction stops killing conversion.
Catalog: https://docs.rutinhq.com/catalog/store-os/

### NEXUS OS
URL: https://www.rutinhq.com/nexus-os
Hub thesis: Agentic marketing — Strategy → Social → Ads (Ads gated until creatives, mix, and budget are signed).
Headline: Agentic marketing — paper first, Ads only when signed.
Subhead: Strategy → Social → Ads. Until creatives, mix, and budget have an explicit GO: paper only (no pixel, no spend).
Catalog: https://docs.rutinhq.com/catalog/nexus-os/
